filter.$description: Tokens for FilterButton and FilterMenu: the search bar's pill filters (Space Use, Rent, Size, All Filters). Measured from the audit's search results capture (quick-search-filters) and a reference screenshot of the live bar (2026-10-10). Same height, shape and type as the compact Select beside them, so the bar is one family. Found missing by the search results screen (gaps 1-3).

height.$description: OBSERVED: 40px pills with 16px text on AcmeCo's desktop results (reference screenshots, 2026-10-11). Decision 40 made them 32px to match the compact Select; decision 45 restores 40px, the Select's compact pill with it.

height-touch.$description: OBSERVED: on AcmeCo's phone the pills are 40px tall with 16px text and no chevrons (a reference screenshot, 2026-10-11); below 768px they grow to it, a comfortable touch target (decision 42).

font-size-touch.$description: OBSERVED: 16px pill text on AcmeCo's phone.

padding-x-touch.$description: OBSERVED: about 16px either side on AcmeCo's phone pills.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 4px between a pill's icon, label, count and chevron.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: fully rounded (20px on a 40px pill).

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 16px pill text on AcmeCo's desktop results (reference screenshots, 2026-10-11; decision 45, was 14px).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 100 (the legacy brand typeface thin); became 400 (decision 4).

background-hover.$description: PROPOSED: grey on hover, as the system's other quiet controls.

background-active.$description: OBSERVED: a set filter is light grey (#f3f3f3).

border.$description: OBSERVED: 1px #b2b2b2; became the control border (#808386, decision 5), as on the compact Select, for 3:1.

border-hover.$description: PROPOSED: darker on hover, as the compact Select.

border-active.$description: OBSERVED: a set filter has a 1px #1c1c1c border.

icon-size.$description: PROPOSED: the sliders icon and chevron at 16px, as the compact Select's chevron.

inset.$description: OBSERVED: on the round phone filter button the count sits over its top-right edge (a reference screenshot).

size.$description: OBSERVED: a round count about 20-24px beside All Filters (a reference screenshot).

background.$description: OBSERVED: a blue count; the system's one blue (6.80:1 against white text).

size.$description: PROPOSED: a 24px clear button inside the pill (the 24px target minimum, WCAG 2.5.8), as the chip's remove button.

background-hover.$description: PROPOSED: a darker grey on hover, on the set pill's light grey.

width.$description: PROPOSED: the filter panels' width, as the site menu's panel.

padding.$description: PROPOSED: 8px inside the panel's own 8px padding, so fields sit 16px from its edge.
